disposition_reason: Editorial summarizing Japanese and North American manganese reference values and published Japanese intake estimates.
regulatory_or_exposure: Adequate intake men/women: 2.3/1.8 mg/day North America; 4.0/3.5 mg/day Japan (2020); UL 11 mg/day both (p. 1421)
Japanese adult intake summarized 2.7 to 7.5 mg/day (duplicate portion, 1960s-1980s); 5.1 and 4.9 mg/day (2002-2003 diet records) (p. 1421)
Cohort FFQ intake 5.3 mg/day; green tea 84%, rice 7%, oolong tea 4% (p. 1422)
non_numeric_findings: Manganese not assessed in NHANES Japan.
